advancedComposition.noFocalReason: This original combat HUD prioritizes live status and action readability over decorative hero art.

visualChanges: health and capture bars show live fixture values
primary skill remains the only action-filled control
interactionChanges: all combat intents are enabled and target remains locked

visualChanges: primary skill gains focus ring and target panel gains selected outline
interactionChanges: focus selection changes the next cast intent without changing geometry

visualChanges: disabled skills retain labels and show lock icon plus reduced contrast
interactionChanges: disabled cast intents reject activation and remain discoverable

visualChanges: status panel shows wait label and progress affordance while preserving last values
interactionChanges: combat actions remain enabled but menu opening is deferred until sync completes

visualChanges: target panel replaces health value with error copy and alert row uses feedback treatment
interactionChanges: combat menu remains available; cast intents remain guarded until a target is restored

visualChanges: long labels wrap or ellipsize within their authored rectangles and never cover bars or action targets
interactionChanges: text expansion does not create new intents or move the action bar

evidenceRequirements: separate static, materialization, GPU and runtime verdicts
fresh capture identity with spec hash/profile/state
request intent and screen family match
visual target and reference policy review

designEvidence.brief: 原创竞技战斗 HUD：身份与目标在上方形成对向信息带，任务/警报位于侧栏，战斗状态居中，技能操作固定在安全区底部。

layoutDecisions.decision: player and target panels are separate top siblings; center status owns the combat objective axis
layoutDecisions.reason: 避免目标信息和技能操作争夺同一视觉层级。

layoutDecisions.decision: top panels and quest feed stack vertically while action bar becomes a four-column grid
layoutDecisions.reason: 保留触控尺寸并避免宽屏 HUD 等比缩小。

layoutDecisions.decision: flow/grid parents own child geometry for action and quest groups
layoutDecisions.reason: 消除布局组与子节点绝对 bounds 的双重解释。

conflictHypotheses: long target names may collide with health bars
narrow quest rows may require a scroll fallback
loading and error copy must preserve the center status rectangle
action bar must remain inside safe-area inset

expectedEffects: the regenerated packet keeps the source design contract and asset hashes
wide and narrow geometry remains deterministic
the new evidence is bound to the regenerated spec hash
falsificationChecks: fresh wide and narrow default GPU captures
spec hash and generated-art build ID match

assetDecisions.reason: 增量迭代将原有 fallback 替换为可重复的原创视觉资源。

assumptions.statement: 本版本保留原 ScreenSpec 语义树，仅修订视觉资源、颜色角色和呈现层级。
